newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian BH bank 96 profit up by 29.83 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian BH bank 96 profit up by 29.83 pct.

text.p: Tunisia's housing bank Banque de l'Habitat profits in 1996 amounted to 12.117 million dinars, up by 29.83 percent compared to 9.333 million dinars in 1995, results showed on Tuesday.
It said it will distribute a 0.5 dinar dividend per old share and 0.25 dinar per new share.
The state-controlled bank said its loans for housing in which it is the single specialist amounted to a total 258.711 million dinars in 1996, up by 11.69 percent compared to 1995.
Total balance sheet was 1.175 billion dinars in 1996, up by 13.71 percent compared to 1995. Turnover was 86.689 million dinars, up by 17.26 percent.
BH this year raised its capital to 50 million dinars from 35 million dinars. Its share was last priced 18.62 dinars at the Tunis Stock Exchange. ($=1.08 dinar)
